definitions.explanation: An established set of technical requirements or criteria that products, services, or processes must meet. Used for industrial standards, quality standards, and technical specifications.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{規格|きかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適合|てきごう}している→適合する：25549_tekigousuru⟧。
examples.english: This product conforms to international standards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{規格|きかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たさない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Products that don't meet safety standards cannot be sold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{充電器|じゅうでんき}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規格|きかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧⟦アダプター→アダプター：05251_adaputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Since charger standards differ by country, you need a conversion adapter for overseas travel.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in business, manufacturing, and technology contexts. Japan's main standards body is JIS ({日本産業規格|にほんさんぎょうきかく}, Japanese Industrial Standards).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規格|きかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適合|てきごう}する→適合する：25549_tekigousuru⟧ (to conform to a standard)
- {規格|きかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧ (to meet a standard)
- {国際規格|こくさいきかく} (international standard)
- {安全規格|あんぜんきかく} (safety standard)
- {規格外|きかくがい} (nonstandard, off-spec — also used figuratively for something extraordinary)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧: plan, project — same reading but means planning or a planned project (e.g., ⟦{企画書|きかくしょ}→企画書：20593_kikakusho⟧ "project proposal")
